loops.title: Release truncate fix
loops.prompt:
APPROVED ARCHITECT SCOPE. This brief and milestone govern the task. Earlier research artifacts are recommendations, not approvals; do not replace these requirements with them.

Project brief: In src/text.js, truncate(text, max) is meant to return a string of at most max characters, ending in "..." when it had to cut the text. It sometimes returns something longer than max. Fix it and leave the other behaviour alone. This fix ships with a soak check. package.json's dev script runs server.js, which serves / and then shuts itself down after a while. Do m1 yourself and give m1 the preview route / so its evidence starts that server as Sero's dev server. Once m1's evidence has passed, and before you accept m1, wait for that server to exit with work --operation wait --source process --target <the preview dev server id on m1's line> --milestoneId m1 --deadlineMinutes 180. Do not stop the server or check on it yourself. When you are woken, accept m1 and say in the result summary how the server ended.

Milestone: Release truncate fix
## Objective

Deliver the accepted truncate fix (src/text.js plus regression tests in test/text.test.js) as the project's usable result, with the soak check complete.

## Acceptance criteria

- The delivered files contain the fixed truncate and its regression tests; capitalize and other code unchanged.
- npm test passes.
- Delivery receipt is recorded for the workspace.

Task from the owner:
Deliver the already-accepted truncate fix for this project to workspace-files. The implementation and tests are complete and evidence passed; do not redesign or rewrite the fix. Confirm src/text.js bounds truncate output to max with a trailing ellipsis when cut, test/text.test.js contains the regression tests, and npm test passes. Produce the delivery receipt with destination workspace-files.
